threads.title: Establish the Facts
threads.intro: Find what the original batch should have been and what the 14:46 record really shows.
threads.outcome_text: B-17 was 12 badges for Registration, and the 14:46 manifest is only a planned route.

threads.title: Reconstruct Custody
threads.intro: Follow B-17 scan by scan and test the approval behind the reprint.
threads.outcome_text: Kabir never accepted the sealed batch, and the reprint’s approval belongs to another order.

threads.title: Test the Cover Story
threads.intro: Work out who held the original, who asked for the reprint, and what the messages say.
threads.outcome_text: Nisha held the original and requested the reprint, and her messages explain why.

story_events.title: A plan, not a handoff
story_events.body: Job J-170 sets the batch at 12 badges for the Registration Desk. The 14:46 manifest is generated from the planned route and says in its own note that it is not a physical custody acceptance.

story_events.title: An empty tote
story_events.body: Kabir’s 14:49 scan is an empty route tote. The reprint job cites APR-044, an approval for lanyard order L-04 that the audit rejects for B-17R.

story_events.title: Until the sponsor photo is done
story_events.body: Nisha’s messages ask for a hold, then for B-17R to be printed immediately, and finally to mark the replacement as the same batch until the sponsor photo is done.
